ext.description: MCU Assistant · STM32 compile & flash (Makefile / Keil / pyOCD / OpenOCD)
config.title: MCU-Assistant
cfg.projectDir.desc: Manually specify project directory (fallback when no VS Code workspace is open; workspace takes priority by default)
cfg.targetChip.desc: Target chip (pyOCD target id), used as fallback when auto-detection fails
cfg.autoDetectChip.desc: Auto-detect chip with pyOCD before flashing
cfg.connectUnderReset.desc: Connect under reset (requires nRST pin connected to chip reset)
cfg.elfName.desc: Firmware filename (leave blank to auto-find .elf/.axf/.hex in build/)
cfg.toolchainRootPath.desc: Toolchain root directory. Leave blank to use MCU-Assistant extension storage.
cfg.ghProxy.desc: GitHub download mirror prefix, e.g. https://gh-proxy.com.
cfg.toolchainMode.desc: default = use the extension toolchain directory; custom = prefer the custom paths above.
cfg.projectMode.desc: Project mode: stm32cube (Makefile/GCC), keil5 (Keil UV4), esp32 (ESP32 toolchains)
cfg.esp32SubMode.desc: ESP32 sub-mode: platformio (PlatformIO CLI), arduino (Arduino CLI), idf (ESP-IDF), micropython (MicroPython)
cfg.serialPort.desc: Serial port used for ESP32 flashing. Leave blank to auto-detect.
cfg.hidePlatformIOToolbar.desc: Hide PlatformIO toolbar shortcuts and use the compact MCU-Assistant status bar actions instead.
cfg.autoDownloadDependencies.desc: Automatically download GCC, make, pyOCD, and OpenOCD when the STM32Cube default toolchain is missing.
cfg.platformioCoreDir.desc: Custom PlatformIO Core directory (e.g. D:/tools/platformio). When set, the pio executable is resolved from <dir>/penv/. Leave empty to check the PLATFORMIO_CORE_DIR environment variable. If both are empty, the default path ~/.platformio/penv/ is used, or the CLI is downloaded automatically.
